merge_queue.note: Reported by .github/workflows/ci.yml jobs typescript, rust-check, and bundle-check on pull_request and merge_group.

promotion_model.build_once: cd-npm-cli.yml job stage and cd-pwa.yml job build upload the npm tree, Pages dist, and release metadata. Later jobs download those artifacts.
promotion_model.preview: npm dist-tag alpha and the github-pages deploy run with no GitHub environment approval.
promotion_model.production: The Production environment is the only required-reviewer gate. It downloads the same artifacts, verifies live Pages, and publishes dist-tag next via OIDC. It does not run npm dist-tag add or npm run build.
promotion_model.pages_split: github-pages is the live Pages deploy (actions/deploy-pages). It is not the Preview environment. deploy-pages preview:true is not available to the public, so there is no second Pages environment. Do not add required reviewers to github-pages.

github_environment_changes_via_gh.github_pages: keep branch policy main only (rule 62085543). No required reviewers and no wait timer.
github_environment_changes_via_gh.npm_token: Preview jobs no longer select an environment, so they cannot read the Preview environment secret. They use the repository NPM_TOKEN when set, otherwise OIDC trusted publishing (id-token: write, --provenance). Production publishes with an empty token via OIDC and does not read NPM_TOKEN.

environments.name: Preview
environments.note: No CD job selects this environment. Delete required-reviewer rule 70926078 so a leftover reference cannot wait. See github_environment_changes_via_gh.

secrets.NPM_TOKEN: Unused by current workflows. Preview publish reads the repository secret or uses OIDC. Do not rely on this environment secret.

environments.name: github-pages
environments.role: Automatic live Pages deploy of the immutable artifact from cd-pwa.yml job deploy. Not the Preview environment. No second Preview Pages environment: actions/deploy-pages input preview is not public.

protection_rules.note: Do not add required reviewers. That would put a human wait back on the Pages deploy. Production is the only approval gate.

environments.name: copilot
environments.note: Existing environment; not referenced by new CD workflows. Reserved for Copilot/automation integrations.

npm_versioning.bump: increment the numeric suffix on 0.0.0-alpha.N from the npm registry

dist_tags.preview_publish: alpha (Preview publishes 0.0.0-alpha.N with no environment wait)
dist_tags.production_promotion: next (Production npm publish --tag next via OIDC; never latest, never dist-tag add)

npm_packages.name: @opensesame-labs/web-pwa
npm_packages.payload: Built static dist (HTML, JS, WASM, manifest, service worker) from the same production Pages build uploaded to GitHub Pages

npm_trusted_publishing.oidc_fallback: Preview publishes with the repository NPM_TOKEN when set, otherwise id-token: write and npm trusted publishing with --provenance. Production publishes with an empty token. CD never runs npm dist-tag add.
npm_trusted_publishing.allowed_action: direct npm publish (stage publish alone is not sufficient; dist-tag permission is not used)

npmjs_fields.workflow_filename: filename only, including .yml, not the .github/workflows path
